system.description: You learn either the @UUID[Compendium.a5e.a5e-spells.Item.omvngnmoo75is54f]{Spare the Dying} or @UUID[Compendium.a5e.a5e-spells.Item.bpkked98u8mb2q3w]{Chill Touch} cantrip. At 3rd level, you learn either @UUID[Compendium.a5e.a5e-spells.Item.it4gev1vr8gmecok]{False Life} or @UUID[Compendium.a5e.a5e-spells.Item.5qkmd21kyg7vedcz]{Inflict Wounds}. At 5th level, you learn either @UUID[Compendium.a5e.a5e-spells.Item.6q34ttse78toj5x0]{Blindness/Deafness} or @UUID[Compendium.a5e.a5e-spells.Item.0ou0qutr7p2bedg0]{Darkness}. You may cast these spells once per long rest without expending a spell slot or requiring material components. Your spellcasting modifier for these spells is either Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma, whichever is highest.
